ideas.pitch: An offline-first autonomous AI agent deployed on Geeta University campus infrastructure to monitor local server latency, optimize Wi-Fi bandwidth allocation during peak hours, and automatically alert campus IT of hardware failures via LLM-parsed syslog data.
ideas.title: CampusPulse AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting the real-world AI solutions track with an offline campus-specific utility directly appeals to on-campus judges looking for practical infrastructure use cases.

ideas.pitch: A Web3 local produce escrow and micro-payments system built for farmers in Haryana, removing intermediaries by using smart contracts for instant crop payment upon logistics verification.
ideas.title: AgriSettle Decentralized Mandi
ideas.why_it_could_win: Fits the decentralized Web3 systems track by solving an immediate local economic problem relevant to the rural-urban setting of Panipat.

ideas.pitch: A local zero-knowledge peer-to-peer file sharing and credential locker that operates completely without internet connectivity, utilizing WebRTC and local cryptographic proofs for secure campus collaboration.
ideas.title: ZeroShare Offline Vault
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates genuinely hard engineering with local-first networking and cryptography, targeting the open innovation track.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered academic evaluation assistant that parses handwritten assignment images uploaded by professors, runs multi-agent rubric grading, and provides instant personalized feedback loops.
ideas.title: AutoGrade AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly impacts the academic environment of Geeta University, making it instantly relatable and practical for judges evaluating real-world AI applications.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous event coordination agent for multi-day offline hackathons that matches lost participants with missing team members, automates mentor scheduling, and handles submission deadline pings.
ideas.title: LocalLocus Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses an immediate pain point of running a 24-hour offline hackathon on a university campus, showing high contextual awareness in the open innovation track.
